title: Notes application
summary: Local notes app with create/list/search/delete using SQLite and standard library HTTP server
features: Create note with title and body
risks: SQLite file corruption if interrupted during write
Browser XSS if body not escaped
Port already in use by another process

tasks.title: Initialize project structure and SQLite database
tasks.instructions: Create app.py with SQLite schema for notes table (id, title, body, created_at). Implement GET /health returning {"status":"ok"}. Add basic error handling. Create server function create_server(host, port) returning HTTPServer.

tasks.title: Implement note creation endpoint
tasks.instructions: Add POST /api/notes endpoint accepting JSON with title and body. Validate inputs (non-empty title). Insert into SQLite with timestamp. Return 201 with created note object. Handle duplicates by rejecting or updating.

tasks.title: Implement list notes endpoint
tasks.instructions: Add GET /api/notes returning JSON array of all notes sorted by id descending. Each note includes id, title, body, created_at. Ensure response is valid JSON with proper encoding.

tasks.title: Implement search notes endpoint
tasks.instructions: Add GET /api/notes/search?q= query parameter. Filter notes where title contains query string (case-insensitive). Return matching notes as JSON array. Handle empty query by returning all notes.

tasks.title: Implement delete note endpoint
tasks.instructions: Add DELETE /api/notes/{id} endpoint. Accept note id from URL path. Delete from SQLite and return 204 or 200 with confirmation. Return 404 if not found.

tasks.title: Create HTML interface for browser access
tasks.instructions: Create static HTML served at GET / with form to create notes, list display, search box, delete buttons. Use proper escaping for user input. Include basic CSS for usability. Ensure all endpoints are accessible from UI.

tasks.title: Integration tests and final validation
tasks.instructions: Create main block accepting --host and --port arguments. Run server with http.server module. Verify all endpoints work: create note, list notes, search, delete. Test persistence by restarting server. Ensure health check passes.
